task: Stop Koala runtime artifacts such as activity logs from polluting material freshness and DONE gates.
outcome: After the fix, a user can run `koala doctor` and see `Runtime artifacts: no tracked runtime artifacts found`; `npm run test:entrypoints` and `npm run test:verification-freshness` pass; and a tracked `.koala/activity.jsonl` no longer makes verification evidence stale.
facts: runtime-fact-registry exists but only covers environment facts, not artifact paths
process-fact-registry covers process evidence, not runtime file volatility
currentMaterialHash excludes story metadata but not .koala/activity.jsonl
koala init skips existing .gitignore instead of merging required ignore patterns
doctor currently repairs orphan worktrees but not tracked runtime artifacts
constraints: Use a single hard-coded registry as source of truth for runtime artifact paths
Do not classify source, requirements, package files, or koala.config.json as runtime artifacts
Keep story metadata under .koala/story as process evidence, not runtime noise
Existing projects with user .gitignore must preserve user content while adding Koala runtime ignore entries
Repair must not automatically untrack files unless user requests doctor --repair
